meta_description: Oakwood Painting & Decorating in Nottingham. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full redecoration. Free quotes, local team, attention to detail.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to beautiful finishes. We handle interior redecorations, exterior painting, and wallpapering across Nottingham with care and precision.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or your entire property redecorated, we deliver quality finishes on time and to budget.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls painted to a flawless finish. We prepare properly, use premium paints, and protect your furnishings throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof coatings for fascias, soffits, doors, and brickwork. We use exterior-grade paints that protect your home from the British climate for years.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Pattern matching, bespoke hanging, and feature walls executed with precision. We remove old paper, prepare surfaces, and hang new stock flawlessly.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Artex, Venetian plaster, and contemporary textured effects. Perfect for adding depth and character to any interior space.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office buildings, retail spaces, and commercial properties painted on time and on budget, with minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Surface Preparation
services.desc: Comprehensive prep work including filling, sanding, and priming. We never cut corners—the foundation determines the finish quality.

about_pullquote: I set up Oakwood because I believed homeowners deserved reliable decorators who actually take pride in their work.
about_para_1: Oakwood Painting & Decorating was established 15 years ago with one simple aim: to deliver beautiful, durable finishes at fair prices. Over that time we've built a reputation across Nottingham for meticulous preparation, colour advice you can trust, and workmanship that lasts. We've redecorated homes, offices, and commercial spaces from Aspley to Beeston, always with the same commitment to getting it right.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we show up on time, and we leave your property spotless. We're not the cheapest—we're the best value. That means proper preparation, premium paints where they matter, and decorators who care about the detail. Many of our jobs come from recommendation, which says more about us than any advert ever could.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway decorated. The lads were brilliant—prep work was thorough, they protected everything, and the finish is absolutely pristine. Mike even colour-matched a tricky wall. Would definitely book them again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Exterior of our Victorian terrace needed serious attention. They didn't just paint over the problems—they sanded, filled, and primed properly. Three years on and it still looks fresh. Honest advice, no rushing. Top job.
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Helped us choose wallpaper for our feature wall and hung it perfectly. The whole house is now done. Professional, clean, and they tidy up after themselves. Fair pricing too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James L.
